questions.question: Name four common kinds of transport people use in South Africa today, and say which is the most common public transport.
questions.expected_answer: People walk, ride bicycles, drive cars and take minibus taxis, buses and trains. Minibus taxis are the most common kind of public transport.

questions.question: How are goods moved on land in South Africa?
questions.expected_answer: Most goods are carried by trucks on roads. Freight trains carry heavy goods, such as coal and iron ore, over long distances to harbours. Smaller goods go in vans and bakkies, and fuel is pumped through pipelines.

questions.question: What damage do exhaust fumes cause in big cities, and give two ways people can reduce it?
questions.expected_answer: Exhaust fumes pollute the air and can form smog. Dirty air makes eyes sting, causes coughing and makes asthma worse, harms plants and animals, and adds to climate change. People can walk or cycle, use buses and trains, share lifts, keep vehicles serviced, use electric vehicles and plant trees.
